title: Hopf decomposition of the actions of subgroups of the mapping class group
summary: We study the Hopf decomposition of subgroup actions of the Teichmüller modular group on the Thurston boundary with respect to the Thurston measure class. We identify the conservative part with the big horospherical limit set modulo null sets. For a basepoint with trivial stabilizer in the subgroup, the ideal boundary of the associated Dirichlet polyhedron is wandering, and its subgroup translates cover the dissipative part modulo null sets.
